name: Black Rosario
source:
He is said to be a successful work of the goddess.

A boy who is called a "mistake" by Black Lily. He is very timid and shy.

Beside the half-split, always questions the existence of himself.

"Then I was... what was I made for?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
